name: Sprasa Accounts
tagline: Billing and accounting software built to Nepal's IRD electronic billing rules: locked invoice numbers, PAN and VAT modes, reprint tracking and a full audit trail.
highlights: Issued bills can't be edited, only voided or credited
Fiscal-year serial numbers with no gaps
PAN mode and VAT mode (13% VAT, buyer PAN rule)
Original copy and stamped, logged reprints
Chart of accounts and ledger posting
